title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the temperature of the shell as T_1 = T / (2^(1/4)).

title: Power Reduction Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must explain that the total power radiated is reduced by half due to the heat shield's radiation back to the sphere.

title: Radiative Equilibrium Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of radiative equilibrium and the relationship between the sphere and the shell.

title: Impact of Additional Shields
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss how adding more heat shields continues to reduce the total power radiated.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs in the equations for power or temperature.
